entry_points.summary: Async coroutine: creates worktree, spawns pi session, polls status, handles crash retries and halt relay, acquires merge_lock around merge_workstream. Semaphore held for full spawn→merge lifetime.
Greedy graph-coloring: splits a dependency-level's workstreams into conflict-safe sub-batches. scope_unknown or serialize_all triggers singleton sub-batches (fully serial).
Returns workstreams whose entire depends_on set has reached terminal 'done'. Sole scheduling gate (INV-2).
Async: reads workstreams.json, applies crash recovery, runs compute_ready_level→partition_level→asyncio.gather loop. Accepts merge_lock from run_cross_plan for cross-plan serialization.

Multi-slug entry point. Calls build_plan_conflict_graph, acquire_plan_locks (sorted ascending), schedule_batches, asyncio.gather bounded by plan_sem. Creates shared asyncio.Lock threaded into all run_single_plan calls.
Builds plan-level conflict adjacency map: scope intersection or either plan scope_unknown/low-confidence/missing → conflict. Fail-safe: unknown scope always conflicts.
Acquires plan-claim.sh locks in sorted ascending slug order (INV-6: deadlock-free). Releases all on any failure. Returns (ok, held_slugs).
Greedy batch coloring over plan conflict graph: conflict-free plans grouped in same batch, conflicting plans serialized across batches.
Computes longest-path depth for each workstream over depends_on DAG. Sets parallel_group='level-{depth}'. Same-depth workstreams are mutually independent (Rule 7 enforced by validate_workstreams).
Parses **Files:** lines per task block in TASKS.md. If any task block lacks parseable **Files:** line, scope_unknown=True → forces full serialization (INV-4).
Synchronous git merge --no-ff of hermes/<slug>/<ws_id> into base. Called under in-process asyncio.Lock — never concurrent across workstreams or plans.

Reads hermes-config.yaml (repo root then ~/.config/hermes/config.yaml) into HermesConfig. Concurrency/retry/timeout are file-only; HERMES_DISCORD_TOKEN/HERMES_DISCORD_USER_ID are the only env overrides.
Parses workstreams.json into typed WorkstreamsManifest dataclass. Consumed by hermes-execute.py at plan start.
Creates git worktree at ../hermes-<slug>-<ws_id> on branch hermes/<slug>/<ws_id>. Handles crash-recovery path (branch exists, worktree missing).
Runs pi z-execute --tasks=<path> as detached subprocess (start_new_session=True). Returns PID.

invariants: INV-1: Concurrent workstreams write to isolated git worktrees; the working tree is never shared.
INV-2: depends_on is the sole scheduling gate — a workstream starts only when all depends_on IDs reach 'done'. parallel_group is a derived label, NOT a scheduling mechanism.
INV-3: merge_order is authoritative for merge sequence — merges always proceed in declared order, never completion order.
INV-4: scope_unknown=True or serialize_all=True forces fully-sequential execution (singleton sub-batches). Silent blind parallelism is forbidden when conflict data is absent or low-confidence.
INV-5: max_parallel_workstreams=1 (default) reproduces pre-v1.3 sequential behavior exactly. cap=1 ≡ legacy sequential.
INV-6: Plan-claim locks are always acquired in sorted ascending slug order — prevents AB/BA deadlocks across concurrent orchestrators.
INV-7: parallel_group and scope_unknown are additive fields (forward-compatible). Pre-v1.3 manifests omitting scope_unknown default to false; null parallel_group treated as scope_unknown (fail-safe).
gotchas: DORMANT BY DEFAULT (v1.4): workflow.hermes_enabled defaults to false in .z-harness/config.toml. All workstream-generation, handoff writes, and cross-plan dispatch calls inside commands are no-ops unless hermes_enabled=true.

TWO SEPARATE CONFIG SYSTEMS: scripts/config.py reads workflow.hermes_enabled from .z-harness/config.toml (the command-layer gate). scripts/hermes/config.py reads hermes-config.yaml for Hermes runtime behavior (concurrency caps, retries, timeouts). These are independent; setting workflow.* in config.toml does NOT directly configure the Hermes runtime.

HERMES_* env vars REMOVED: HERMES_MAX_PARALLEL, HERMES_MAX_PARALLEL_PLANS, HERMES_SERIALIZE_ALL, HERMES_SERIALIZE_HIGH_SEVERITY, HERMES_WORKSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MINUTES, HERMES_MAX_RETRIES have no effect. Only HERMES_DISCORD_TOKEN and HERMES_DISCORD_USER_ID remain as env overrides.
Semaphore held for FULL run_workstream lifetime (spawn through merge). Bounds live sessions, not spawn rate.
poll_session runs via asyncio.to_thread — blocking I/O cannot stall sibling workstream monitors.
GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 set for full run and restored after — prevents concurrent git gc contention against the shared object store.
scope_unknown is derived from parse_task_files: if ANY task block in TASKS.md lacks a parseable **Files:** line, the entire plan is scope_unknown=True.
Merge lock is a single in-process asyncio.Lock shared across all workstreams and all plans within one run_cross_plan. No two merges ever run concurrently.
Non-file shared state (databases, ports, remote sandboxes, in-memory caches) is NOT protected by the file-conflict layer. Use serialize_all=true in hermes-config.yaml.
scripts/hermes/ files are kept (not deleted) to prevent bit-rot while dormant. Deletion is a separate future task.
